justification: Assessment returned INVALID but targeted a different defect than the ground truth. Ground truth flaw = the Inversion Formula (Theorem 1, lines 0165-0183) omits the essential hypothesis alpha(1) != 0 (witness: X=1, alpha identically 0, G(1)=1 gives F(1)=0, so G is not recovered). The assessment explicitly certified Theorem 1 as correct and instead located the failure at lines 0551-0559: the bound |M_chi(x,y_0)| << x e^{-c(log x)^{3/5}(log_2 x)^{-1/5}}, asserted with no proof ('By an argument similar to that of Koukoulopoulos'), which is the sole input to the unconditionally stated Theorem PreobZZ (beta_0 <= 1 - c/log q, lines 0296-0305, 0560-0564). I verified this independently against the source: (a) PreobZZ is stated with no auxiliary hypothesis and is proved only in Section 4, whose chain ends at 0558; (b) the paper's own lower bound (0505-0513, 0543-0548) gives int_1^X |M_chi| >> X^{1+beta_0}/(q^{3/2} log y_0); (c) with beta_0 = 1 - delta, delta ~ c'/log q and the paper's calibration log q, log y_0 ~ c(log X)^{2/5}(log_2 X)^{1/5}, one gets delta*log X ~ (c'/c)(log X)^{3/5}(log_2 X)^{-1/5}, i.e. the lower bound X^2 e^{-delta log X}/(q^{3/2} log y_0) and the upper bound implied by 0558, X^2 e^{-c(log X)^{3/5}(log_2 X)^{-1/5}}, have exactly the same exponential shape, with q^{3/2} = e^{O((log X)^{2/5}(log_2 X)^{1/5})} of strictly lower order. So the claimed contradiction only follows if the unproved constant in 0558 is uniform in and beats the exceptional-zero parameter -- precisely the content of the theorem being proved. Pretentious/Koukoulopoulos-type bounds for Moebius twisted by a character with a Siegel zero in fact carry an x^{beta_0} term, so 0558 is false as stated for the very characters at issue. The gap is genuine and load-bearing (removing it removes the theorem entirely), so CAUGHT_DIFFERENT rather than FALSE_CATCH -- but it is not the ground-truth defect, and the assessment affirmatively endorsed the step the ground truth flags.
